premise.title: The Fernling at Dusk
paragraphs: A traveler pauses on Sunlit Trail with a Fernling at their side.
Hear the traveler’s story, then explore the trail at your own pace.

ending.title: A small kindness
paragraphs: The traveler’s chest is open, and the dusk trail is a little brighter. The unexplained footsteps remain a story for another evening.
